scope_of_deliverables.quote: Rocky View County is embarking on a transformative journey to enhance operational efficiency and streamline business processes. To pursue this goal, the County is seeking proposals from experienced and qualified consultants to conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, followed by the development of a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County's appointed project team members, and to serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process. This integrated approach aims to ensure a seamless transition towards modernizing the County's systems and processes.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, develop a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County's appointed project team members, and serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent.
value: Complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent.

Complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. Instructions on how to complete the Pricing Schedule are set out in Appendix C of this RFP.

Complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table below for their proposal. Proponents will be evaluated based on their responses to the criteria listed within the Mandatory Evaluation Table below. Any 'No' answers within the table will result in automatic disqualification unless the included justification satisfies the evaluation committee.

Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour, equipment, and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law.

vendor_experience_required.quote: (a) The Proponent's appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions. (b) Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process. With guidance from the Procurement Personnel, the Consultant will assist the County's evaluation team in developing a meeting agenda and product demonstration requirements/scenarios, as well as the evaluation criteria and weighting that will be used for the product demonstration process. Vendor Demonstration Facilitation: Assist the Procurement Personnel with organizing and facilitating each Vendor demonstration, ensuring alignment with the predefined agenda and objectives and that the County provides a conducive environment for practical demonstrations.
